name: BDLocation Checkout Dropdowns for WooCommerce
author: Salauddin Ahmed Bhuiyan

sections.description:
BDLocation Checkout Dropdowns for WooCommerce adds structured Bangladesh location dropdowns to the WooCommerce checkout page.

Customers can select their Bangladesh location through dependent dropdown fields, making address entry easier and more consistent for local WooCommerce stores.

The plugin is designed specifically for Bangladesh-focused WooCommerce websites.

Features

  • Bangladesh Division dropdown
  • District dropdown based on selected Division
  • Thana/Upazila dropdown based on selected District
  • Searchable location selection
  • Dependent location dropdowns
  • WooCommerce checkout integration
  • Bangladesh-focused location data
  • Lightweight frontend assets
  • Responsive checkout interface
  • Admin settings for checkout location fields
  • No external API required for the location dropdown functionality

Location Coverage

The bundled location data includes:

  • 8 Divisions
  • 64 Districts
  • 499 Upazilas
  • Bangladesh location hierarchy for WooCommerce checkout

How It Works

After installation and activation:

  1. Go to WooCommerce checkout.
  2. Select a Division.
  3. Select the corresponding District.
  4. Select the corresponding Thana/Upazila.
  5. Complete the remaining checkout information and place the order.

The available District and Thana/Upazila options are automatically filtered according to the previous selection.

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.2 or later
  • PHP 7.4 or later
  • WooCommerce

License

sections.installation:
1. Download and install the plugin.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  3. Upload the plugin ZIP file.
  4. Install and activate the plugin.
  5. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and activated.
  6. Visit your WooCommerce checkout page and configure the available location fields as needed.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce is required for the checkout integration.

Does it require an external API?

No. The location dropdown functionality uses bundled Bangladesh location data.

Can customers search for locations?

Yes. The location fields support searchable selection.

Are the dropdowns dependent on each other?

Yes. District options are filtered based on the selected Division, and Thana/Upazila options are filtered based on the selected District.

Is it designed for Bangladesh WooCommerce stores?

Yes. The plugin is specifically designed for Bangladesh-focused WooCommerce checkout experiences.
